tagline: Prepare media delivery choices that can be checked.
introduction: A media-workflow companion for Cloudinary documentation, helping plan transformations, asset metadata and delivery validation.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Cloudinary? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Plan responsive media delivery
capabilities.description: Define useful media variants and quality checks for a user experience.

capabilities.title: Review a transformation idea
capabilities.description: Explain a supplied transformation URL or specification and its assumptions.

capabilities.title: Organize asset metadata
capabilities.description: Plan naming, provenance and review information for an asset set.

starterPrompts: Plan image variants for a mobile pet catalogue with clear crop, format and accessibility checks.
